changelog:
- Initial release of xwbl skill: "inquiry-transcript-generator-basic".
- Enables generation and management of inquiry transcripts based on user inputs such as basic case facts, templates, and original records.
- Supports generation of inquiry outlines, structured transcript Q&A, personnel extraction, and export to Word/HTML/text formats.
- Emphasizes fact anchoring: all details must come from user materials—no invention of facts.
- Outlines detailed workflows for observation, reasoning, generation, review, and web tool replication.
- Includes thorough input requirements, export options, quality checks, and mandatory human review reminders.
summary: Builds and operates an inquiry transcript generator. Invoke for基本案情生成询问提纲、笔录分析、涉案人员提取、模板化笔录生成或复刻网页工具.
